identityEvidence: The complete source archive defines the Citrus Rush boardwalk lemonade game and its recipes, shifts, daily challenge and custom engine. No installed bundle or Citrus Rush entry matches. No identity or successor inferred from shared scaffold or engine keys.
sourceDateEvidence: Neither the export nor prior Drive audit establishes an original creation date. Filesystem and Drive upload dates are not used as a claimed creation day.
harnessEvidence: Grok app-builder source scaffold and exact artifact hash match the earlier Grok Drive source audit.
transform: Compile the supplied client game and router into portable HTML; embed original assets, original head font URLs and favicon. Database migrations are not part of the client game build.
Canonicalize alias and relative imports to a single module identity in the builder, preventing duplicated Zustand state. Remove a misplaced build hook in the recovered builder.
Correct a single WebGL postprocess UV sign so the scene renders upright.
Resolve pointer controls through the closest action button and remember pointer/action pairs through capture, so release actually clears the held control.
Disable scaffold authentication for the portable client game and remove account buttons. Game simulation, recipes, shifts, scoring and save keys retained.
